name: Horse-Drawn Streetcars
description: Horse-drawn trolleys roll along Main Street amid the area’s turn-of-the-century atmosphere.

name: Dapper Dans
description: A barbershop quartet harmonizes on classic songs along Main Street.

name: Meet Mickey Mouse at Town Square Theater
description: Families can meet Mickey dressed in his magician’s best inside Town Square Theater.

name: Walt Disney World Railroad
description: A vintage steam locomotive makes a one-and-a-half-mile circuit around Magic Kingdom.

name: Swiss Family Treehouse
description: Guests climb stairs and rope bridges through the shipwrecked family’s detailed treetop home.

name: The Magic Carpets of Aladdin
description: Colorful flying carpets circle the marketplace while riders control their height and dodge surprise sprays of water.

name: Walt Disney's Enchanted Tiki Room
description: Singing birds, drumming tikis, and blooming flowers turn the room into an animated musical chorus.

name: Jungle Cruise

name: Pirates of the Caribbean
description: A dark boat ride sails through misty caverns and a lively pirate raid led by familiar captains.

name: The Beak and Barrel

name: Country Bear Musical Jamboree
description: Animatronic bears perform a toe-tapping stage show mixing country humor with Disney songs in bluegrass and Americana styles.

description: A runaway mine train races through desert canyons, tunnels, trestles, and red-rock ridges.

name: Tom Sawyer Island
description: The former island experience sat within the Rivers of America and was reached by raft.
availabilityNote: closed permanently since July 2025 for the Piston Peak expansion

name: Liberty Square Riverboat

availabilityNote: closed permanently since July 2025 for the Piston Peak expansion

name: Rafts to Tom Sawyer Island
description: Rafts formerly carried guests across the Rivers of America to Tom Sawyer Island.
availabilityNote: closed permanently since July 2025 for the Piston Peak expansion

name: Piston Peak Off-Road Rally Race

name: Let the Magic Begin

name: Mickey's Magical Friendship Faire

name: Disney Festival of Fantasy Parade
description: Towering floats, dancers, beloved characters, and a fire-breathing Maleficent dragon sweep through the park.

name: Happily Ever After
description: Fireworks, projections, and music transform Cinderella Castle and the sky for the park’s signature evening spectacular.

name: Disney Starlight: Dream the Night Away
description: Glowing floats, synchronized lighting, costumes, and sweeping music fill the park’s nighttime parade.

name: Meet Peter Pan
description: Guests may greet Peter Pan for a character moment in Fantasyland.

name: Meet Ariel
description: Guests can meet Ariel for an under-the-sea character moment.

name: Meet Mirabel
description: Families can celebrate with Mirabel during a Fantasyland character greeting.

name: Meet Cinderella
description: Guests can share a royal character moment with Cinderella.

name: Prince Charming Regal Carrousel

name: Mickey's PhilharMagic
description: Donald Duck borrows the Sorcerer’s Hat and launches a 3D musical whirlwind through Disney worlds.

name: Mad Tea Party
description: Oversized teacups spin beneath a canopy of glowing lanterns.

name: Peter Pan's Flight
description: Suspended pirate ships fly over London and Never Land before encountering Captain Hook.

name: 'it’s a small world'
description: A gentle indoor boat journey passes hundreds of Audio-Animatronic dolls singing and dancing in regional dress.

description: Honey-pot vehicles drift through Pooh’s blustery, bouncy, dreamlike adventures before a warm celebration.

description: The transcript presents the restaurant inside Beast’s Castle as a highly sought-after character-dining experience.

description: Clamshell vehicles descend into Ariel’s world for songs, underwater celebration, Ursula’s bargain, and a happy finale.

name: Space Mountain

name: TRON Lightcycle / Run

name: DiVine

description: Guests may meet Pluto near the Oasis path.

name: Viva Gaia Street Band!

name: Tropical Americas Animal Carousel

name: Meet Figment

name: Soarin' Across America

name: Awesome Planet
